description: Machine-readable summary of the four-layer evidence matrix and which verification cases cover each layer. Companion to references/evidence-matrix.md.

counts.pre_c2_baseline_status: PRE-C2 baseline, retained for audit only; not the C2 acceptance claim
counts.c2_note: C2 ships >=30 verification cases; docs/evidence/freeze-manifest.json (owned by P4) is the authoritative instance-level enumeration.

layers.name: Configuration
layers.evidence: The artifact is correctly constituted: files exist, frontmatter is complete, JSON parses, paths are consistent, ownership is declared, frozen hashes match, case counts reconcile. Static; no program runs against behavior.
layers.machine_check: python -c 'import json;json.load(open(...))' for every JSON; CJK regex scan with count == 0; SHA-256 compare against the freeze manifest; frontmatter field-count assert; ../-base grep; ownership table diff; 19/19 vs >=30 reconciliation.
layers.failure_mode: Missing file, schema mismatch, undeclared owner, mixed path base, frozen artifact changed, self-hash gap, missing frontmatter field.
layers.pdca_state: PASS if every config assertion is green; FAIL for a concrete assertion failure (E02, E07); UNCERTAIN if a config file cannot be read or a manifest is absent.

layers.name: Execution
layers.evidence: A command actually ran and produced real output: exit codes, pasted PASS lines, 0 exceptions, persisted writes. Dynamic but not yet consumed by a real user.
layers.machine_check: node selftest.js (capture stdout, assert PASS count and 0 JS exceptions); node panel.js start|stop; PUT-persistence assert; clipboard-path assert; node:sqlite presence check; grep for the literal string 'should work' in Check sections.
layers.failure_mode: Command not run, false 'should work' claim, snapshot copy failed, PUT rollback, degradation shim invoked, no Check evidence.
layers.pdca_state: PASS if all commands ran with pasted PASS output; FAIL if a performed command returned negative (E01, E05, E06, E09, E11); UNCERTAIN if a command could not be executed at all (E12).

layers.name: Consumer-load
layers.evidence: A real consumer loaded the artifact: CDP-driven Chrome rendered the panel, a cold reader consumed the docs with no context, a browser actually copied the snapshot, state survived a reload.
layers.machine_check: CDP suite attached to Chrome --headless=new --remote-debugging-port=9224; cold-read protocol (3 readers, no context); /data/ returns 403 and only /api/* is read; clipboard event fired by a real user gesture; reload-survival assert.
layers.failure_mode: 'The page opens' claimed as delivery, Chrome unavailable / UI unverified, raw JSON read directly, presence-gate false start, consumer observed a defect.
layers.pdca_state: PASS if a real consumer loaded it cleanly; UNCERTAIN if the consumer was unavailable so the UI is unverified (E12, UNCERTAIN wins over FAIL here); FAIL if the consumer loaded it and observed a defect (E03, E05).

layers.name: Acceptance
layers.evidence: The stated acceptance criteria were met and can be discriminated: all 2x2 cells populated, statistical power sufficient, blinding intact, no veto fired, PDCA verdict with pasted evidence.
layers.machine_check: 2x2 cell-completeness assert; p_min <= 0.05 power assert; per-cell discrimination statistic; blind-key exposure scan; veto-condition scan; PDCA three-state verdict with evidence lines.
layers.failure_mode: Underpowered experiment, missing 2x2 cell, no discrimination in a failure cell, unblinding, frozen-artifact veto, contradictory criteria.
layers.pdca_state: PASS only if all criteria met, evidence pasted and no veto; UNCERTAIN if the experiment is underpowered or evidence incomplete (E04, E08, E10); FAIL / VOID if a veto fired or a criterion was contradicted (E07, E08).

cases.description: CJK scan over all owned English files: count == 0
json.load on every docs/evidence/*.json including P4 freeze files
Frozen SHA-256 matches files; manifest self-hash present (no gap)
8 required frontmatter fields present in every cold-read report
Package-root-relative paths consistent; gaps list matches references/panel.md; deviation NOT a gap
Mutually-exclusive file ownership: every path has exactly one owner
Case-count reconciliation: 19/19 PRE-C2 baseline vs >=30 C2
node selftest.js runs, PASS lines pasted, exit 0
Check sections contain real output; literal 'should work' absent
node:sqlite active, Node >= 22.5, no degradation shim
Snapshot clipboard: navigator + execCommand both PASS
PUT persists to SQLite; rollback detected and handled
Incremental reconciler; no full-page re-render
Presence-gate skip path: absent -> skipped: not present, zero spend
CDP Chrome renders panel; 0 JS exceptions / console errors
UI never reads raw JSON: /data/ 403, /api/* only
3 cold readers consumed docs with no context (M1 fixed)
Snapshot actually copied in browser by a real user gesture
Reload survival: time / status / columns / command / reply
2x2 experiment: all four cells populated and recorded
Statistical power: p_min <= 0.05 with enough paired cards
Unblinding check: blind keys not exposed before scoring
PDCA three-state verdict with precedence and pasted evidence
Veto rules + voided-round-as-correction (E07 / E08)

pre_c2_selftest_mapping.note: The PRE-C2 19/19 selftest suite covered execution + consumer-load only; it had no configuration or acceptance cases, which is why the cold-read defects went undetected.

precedence: A veto wins over a positive primary result (E07, E08).
UNCERTAIN wins over FAIL when evidence is incomplete (E02, E08, E10, E12).
FAIL for a produced negative result (E03, E04, E05, E06, E09, E11).
PASS only if all criteria met, all four layers green, evidence pasted, no veto.

rules: preserved as evidence, never edited or deleted
no PASS/FAIL score and no scoreboard change
new round re-frozen with new hashes by P4
